content.short: Polymesh is an institutional-grade, permissioned Layer 1 blockchain specifically designed for regulated assets.
content.description:
Polymesh is a leading institutional-grade Layer 1 blockchain engineered to overcome the barriers to adopting security tokens and regulated digital assets. Unlike general-purpose networks, Polymesh is a permissioned blockchain that bakes identity, compliance, and confidentiality directly into the core runtime. This approach ensures that all participants are verified and that every transaction meets rigorous regulatory standards, making it a primary venue for capital markets and institutional-level asset management.

The network is powered by the POLYX utility token, which facilitates transaction fees, staking, and decentralized governance. Polymesh provides a robust framework for the tokenization, issuance, and settlement of real-world assets (RWAs), providing institutional participants with the transparency and efficiency typically found only in decentralized environments. Through its commitment to regulatory alignment and technical innovation, Polymesh is building the essential infrastructure for a more secure and efficient global financial system.
content.meta: Polymesh provides a permissioned Layer 1 blockchain for institutional-grade security tokens and regulated assets.
